literature_notes: All three ledger lines concern C-terminal fluorescent-protein fusions (GFP in L1, mEGFP in L2) or vaguely 'differentially tagged' constructs (L3). The FGFRL1 C-terminus (residue 504) lies in the intracellular span (400–504), so these tags are cytoplasmic, not surface-exposed. L3 names no tag type and no residue; the FRET context strongly implies the same C-terminal FP fusions as L1/L2. No ledger line reports a tag on the extracellular face (residues 25–378) of full-length, membrane-anchored FGFRL1. The mature N-terminus (residue 25, after signal-peptide cleavage at 24) is extracellular and would in principle accept a prepended tag, but no ledger line supports such an insertion — the rules forbid proposing sites the ledger does not ground.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal GFP fusion (L1) and C-terminal mEGFP fusion (L2) both append a fluorescent protein after the last residue (C504), which is intracellular; the tagged protein reaches the plasma membrane but the tag faces the cytoplasm.
